# KeyLink

> KeyLink is an AI assistant, an app and done-for-you marketing for real estate agents.
> Ava, the AI assistant, handles missed calls, texts, live answering and showing routes.
> KeyLink also builds CMAs, listing presentations and cinematic listing films.

KeyLink is built in Weatherford, Texas, and works with real estate agents remotely. Plans start at $199 a month plus a one-time build fee, month to month with no contract.

Contact: automate@varekai.ai · (817) 821-1316 · Call Ava: (817) 686-3436
Book a walkthrough: https://www.varekai.ai/book-a-walkthrough

## Services

- [AI Assistant for Agents](https://www.varekai.ai/ai-assistant-for-real-estate-agents): One assistant for your calls, texts, showing routes and real estate questions.
- [Missed-Call Text-Back](https://www.varekai.ai/missed-call-text-back-for-real-estate-agents): Every call you miss gets a text from Ava within seconds, 24/7.
- [Live Call Answering](https://www.varekai.ai/real-estate-answering-service): Ava answers your calls live, 24/7, and handles questions about your listings.
- [Online Lead Follow-Up](https://www.varekai.ai/real-estate-lead-follow-up): Ava contacts new Zillow, Realtor.com, Facebook and website leads within a minute.
- [Listing Presentations and CMAs](https://www.varekai.ai/listing-presentations-and-cmas): Upload your comps and get a branded CMA and listing presentation in minutes.
- [Premiere Listing Videos](https://www.varekai.ai/real-estate-listing-videos): A cinematic listing film, property website, Smart Sign and open house system for one listing.
- [Virtual Staging and Room Edits](https://www.varekai.ai/virtual-staging-for-real-estate-agents): Repaint, change floors, declutter, stage or add twilight from your phone.
- [Showing Routes and Tour Books](https://www.varekai.ai/showing-routes-and-buyer-tour-books): Call Ava from the car to plan your showing day, and give buyers a tour book.
- [Open House Sign-In](https://www.varekai.ai/open-house-sign-in): Visitors scan a QR code to sign in on their own phones, and Ava follows up.
- [Seller Updates and Client Follow-Up](https://www.varekai.ai/seller-updates-and-past-client-follow-up): Weekly seller reports, plus follow-up that keeps past clients hearing from you.
- [Google Reviews and Profile](https://www.varekai.ai/google-reviews-for-real-estate-agents): Review requests, reminders, QR codes, AI-drafted replies and profile support.
- [Social Media and Listing Posts](https://www.varekai.ai/real-estate-social-media-posts): Social posts, just listed and just sold posts, and print-ready postcards.
